author: /root/cloud_intake

cause.summary: POSIX process IDs in the sandbox PID namespace differ from the mounted procfs host ID view; bare numeric comparisons made false group matches and omitted actual descendants.

resolution: Prove self local IDs against NSpid/NSpgid and stat; accept plain procfs fallback only when both actual self PID and PGID match and namespace fields are absent.
Exclude processes proven to be in an ancestor namespace by NSpid depth; remaining candidate namespace links must exactly match /proc/self/ns/pid. Unavailable or ambiguous mapping raises an error.
For matching namespace processes map local PID/PGID from the last NSpid/NSpgid field; verify first fields against procfs IDs/stat PGID and reject nonunique mappings.
Aggregate the verified procfs PPID tree while returning explicit local process_ids, procfs_pids and namespace proof.
Never signal a procfs host PID/PGID. Real termination remains exact Popen-created local process groups; a local signal0 existence probe refuses a live group missing from verified observation.
Existing production nested-session test now asserts namespace proof and captures observations before assertions; no new numerical tolerance or physics case.
new_source_commit: Will be supplied by the root publication receipt; no self-referential commit assertion.
